acceptanceCriteria: A1: CI downloads only the immutable public v0.2.15 Linux Release artifact and verifies archive and binary identity before Runtime use
A2: CI runs installed ai-cockpit verify and preserves the existing Cargo fmt clippy and package test checks as a shadow comparison
A3: Runtime shadow output records tag version archive digest binary digest platform download source and verify result
A4: Missing release asset digest mismatch malformed Runtime output or source fallback fails closed
A5: Phase 1 does not remove or weaken Cargo YAML checks and documents Phase 2 convergence and Phase 3 policy cleanup as future gates
A6: Tri-language documentation explains the CI Runtime shadow boundary and immutable Runtime identity
goal: Establish Phase 1 CI convergence evidence: the immutable installed Runtime runs verify and the existing Cargo checks remain as an independent shadow comparison.
intent: Add a public-release Runtime verification shadow lane to CI without deleting or weakening existing Cargo quality gates.
outOfScope: Deleting or replacing existing Cargo quality checks
Planner tier semantics and affected verification
Performance targets or CI result equivalence claims beyond the shadow lane
Runtime global project state or global Agent/MCP configuration

scenarioCoverage.scenario: immutable public Runtime download and shadow verify
scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact v0.2.15 public binary is verified before it runs verify against the checkout.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the shadow script with the public release and inspect its identity-bound JSON output.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Archive or binary digest mismatch and malformed output stop the CI lane before any governance claim.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run shell regression cases with invalid digest, missing asset, and fake source fallback inputs.
